name: Bulette
summary: A burrowing land shark that leaps from the ground onto prey.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.text: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:str}, each creature in the bulette's destination space. *Failure:* {dmg:3d12:bludgeoning}, and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. *Success:* Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.

bonusActions.name: Leap
bonusActions.text: The bulette jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
